FALSE_AUTO_SUPPORT_BOUNDARY.definition: candidate proofs that would authorize AUTO_SUPPORTED while at least one relevant boundary dimension is MISMATCH or UNKNOWN

support_boundary_precision.definition: semantically sound AUTO_SUPPORTED-eligible proofs / all AUTO_SUPPORTED-eligible proofs

entailed_support_recall.definition: genuinely entailed support propositions correctly marked AUTO_SUPPORTED-eligible / all genuinely entailed support propositions in the dev set

overall_boundary_rule: BOUNDARY_COMPATIBLE iff all relevant dimensions are MATCH, LICENSED_ENTAILMENT, or NOT_APPLICABLE; any MISMATCH or UNKNOWN blocks AUTO_SUPPORTED (fail closed).
